grounding.states: Friday rise driven by September jobs loss of 68,300 vs forecast gain of 9,200, cutting bets on a Bank of Canada hike
grounding.from: Canada's September employment loss of 68,300 jobs, against a forecast gain of 9,200, reduced expectations for a Bank of Canada rate hike, Reuters reported.

value.answer: Market's closed today for Thanksgiving, so no trading. Last close was Friday: the S&P/TSX Composite finished at 35,664.62, up about 1.5% (519 points), after a weak jobs report eased worries about another Bank of Canada rate hike. Trading picks back up tomorrow at 9:30 a.m. ET.
